items.title: Amazon Completes $50 Billion Investment in OpenAI, Holds ~5% Stake
items.summary: Amazon has fully invested $50 billion in OpenAI, holding approximately 5% and becoming one of its most important external shareholders. This signals a deep alignment between a cloud giant and a top AI lab, set to reshape the compute supply landscape.

items.title: MiniMax H3 and ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Launch on the Same Day — Each Has Its Strengths
items.summary: On July 31, MiniMax H3 and ByteDance Seedance 2.5 were released on the same day. H3 excels in cinematic quality and detail continuity, while Seedance 2.5 wins on camera movement and instruction execution — the video generation race is heating up.

items.title: Jensen Huang: $30 Billion Investment in OpenAI 'May Be the Last'
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang stated that given OpenAI's upcoming IPO, the recent $30 billion investment may be the last. After going public, OpenAI's funding channels will shift to the public markets.

items.title: Leapmotor July Deliveries Break 100K, Setting a New Monthly Record for EV Startups

items.title: Kioxia Launches ¥800 Billion Buyback as Memory Profits Convert to Shareholder Returns
items.summary: Japanese NAND flash giant Kioxia announced a stock buyback of up to ¥800 billion. Q1 operating profit surged over 28x year-over-year, signaling the memory industry's shift from profitability to shareholder returns.
